name: Worshipping The Devil
overview: Scripture clearly condemns worshipping the devil, emphasizing that only God alone is worthy of worship and service, as Jesus declared when resisting Satan's temptation (Matthew 4:10). The devil is portrayed as a liar, deceiver, and murderer who opposes the truth and leads people away from God (John 8:44; Revelation 12:9). Believers are called to submit to God, resist the devil, and find salvation through faith in Jesus Christ (James 4:7; Romans 10:9), affirming the exclusive lordship of Christ over all spiritual forces.
